Feature: Student Email & Demo Sign-In
User Story: As a student, I want to sign in with my email/password, Social SSO, or Quick Demo credentials so that I can securely enter my personalized Student Hub.
Acceptance Criteria: Sign-in validates credentials against active users; Quick Demo logs in sarah.c@educateai.org; Suspended accounts are blocked from logging in; Session persists in localStorage.

Feature: Multi-Board & Language Student Sign-Up
User Story: As a new student, I want to register my name, grade (6-12), stream, board, preferred language, and guardian contact so that my curriculum and AI tutor match my syllabus.
Acceptance Criteria: Supports 11 education boards and 10 Indian/English languages; Captures guardian name/phone/email; Binds global board and language on completion.

Feature: Google Maps School Registration & Quota Fallback
User Story: As a registering student, I want to select my school on an interactive map with an automatic fallback list so that signup succeeds even if Maps quota is exceeded.
Acceptance Criteria: SchoolAutocomplete and SchoolLocationMap capture school_name and lat/lng; gmp-quota-exceeded triggers QuotaDefenseBanner and falls back to cached /api/schools list.
Preconditions: User in Sign Up school step

Feature: 7-Day Free Trial Activation & Tracking
User Story: As a newly registered student, I want my 7-Day Free Trial to activate automatically and display remaining days in my portal so that I know my subscription standing.
Acceptance Criteria: Signup initializes subscriptionState with 7-day trial; Sidebar footer and Settings tab display live trial progress bar.

Feature: Edit Student Profile & Academic Context
User Story: As a student, I want to update my grade, stream, board, language medium, phone, password, and guardian details from my profile modal so that my portal adapts immediately.
Acceptance Criteria: Modal updates currentUser and studentsList; Board and language selections propagate immediately to AI Tutor and curriculum filters; Persists across reloads.
Preconditions: Authenticated student clicks My Account or avatar

Feature: DiceBear Preset & Custom Image Avatar Picker
User Story: As a student, I want to pick from preset avatars, generate a custom seed, or upload my own photo so that I can personalize my Student Hub identity.
Acceptance Criteria: Provides 26 DiceBear presets across 4 categories (Students/Robots/Creatives/Fun); Supports custom seed and client-side uploaded image processing.

Feature: 9-Route Navigation & Responsive Drawer
User Story: As a student, I want a clean sidebar navigation with mobile drawer support and Light/Dark mode toggle so that I can access all study modules from any device.
Acceptance Criteria: 8 primary sidebar tabs plus Settings route; Mobile hamburger drawer toggles cleanly; ThemeContext toggles Light/Dark styling across views.

Feature: Academic Context Badges & Workflow Map Access
User Story: As a student, I want to see my active board, grade, date, streak, XP, and quick utility buttons in the header so that key controls stay one click away.
Acceptance Criteria: Header displays Board, Grade, Date, Gamification Hub pills, Offline Pack, Parent Digest, Workflow Map, and Profile Avatar.

Feature: Real-Time Teacher Broadcast Quiz Banner
User Story: As a student, I want to see a live alert banner whenever my teacher broadcasts a quiz so that I can launch the assessment in one click without refreshing.
Acceptance Criteria: Banner shows quiz title, cohort, broadcast time, and question count; Start Assessment sets activeQuizId and routes to Practice Quizzes; Dismissible.

Feature: Real-Time WebSocket Google Meet Invite Banner
User Story: As a student, I want a live class banner with a Join Meeting link whenever a session starts so that I never miss live instruction.
Acceptance Criteria: Receives NEW_MEETING_INVITE over WebSocket; Displays LIVE SESSION badge, host name, and external Join Meeting URL; Dismissible.

Feature: Persistent Quick Doubts AI Popover
User Story: As a student, I want a floating Quick Doubts AI assistant accessible on every tab with diagram attachment support so that I can resolve blockers without leaving my page.
Acceptance Criteria: Floating button available across all 9 routes; Subject selector populated from displaySubjects; Diagram button appends filename prompt; Submits doubt and shows resolution.

Feature: Month Week & Sprint Kanban View Switcher
User Story: As a student, I want to switch my Agile Study Roadmap between Month calendar, Week (Days 8-14), and 5-column Sprint Kanban views so that I can plan at any horizon.
Acceptance Criteria: Month view includes prev/next overflow cells; Week view renders Days 8-14; Sprint view renders To Do/In Progress/On Hold/Revision/Completed columns.

Feature: Status Filter Strip & Sprint Story Points XP Meter
User Story: As a student, I want to filter tasks by status and track earned Story Points XP so that I can focus on pending work and gauge sprint velocity.
Acceptance Criteria: Status pills (All/To Do/In Progress/On Hold/Revision/Done) show accurate live counts; XP progress bar updates immediately on status changes.

Feature: Drag-and-Drop Task Rescheduling & Status Transitions
User Story: As a student, I want to drag tasks between calendar dates or Kanban columns so that adjusting my study schedule takes one gesture.
Acceptance Criteria: Dragging onto any Month/Week day updates date and day; Dragging onto Kanban columns updates status; Triggers real-time cross-panel progress sync.
Preconditions: Task rendered in Month Week or Sprint view

Feature: One-Click Inline Card Status Actions
User Story: As a student, I want quick status buttons directly on task cards so that I can mark tasks In Progress, Revision, or Done without opening a modal.
Acceptance Criteria: Month/Week cards provide Done/In Prog/Revise buttons; Kanban cards provide Progress/Done/Revision buttons; Progress charts update immediately.

Feature: Edit Task Modal with XP Duration Notes & AI Tutor Shortcut
User Story: As a student, I want to edit task topic, status, XP (5-100), duration (0.5-6h), and revision notes—or ask the AI Tutor—so that my study plan stays detailed and actionable.
Acceptance Criteria: Supports XP presets (10/15/20/25/30/50), 0.5h steps, Delete, Save, and Ask AI Tutor shortcut that opens ai-tutor with task context.

Feature: Create New Agile Study Task Modal
User Story: As a student, I want to add new study tasks with day, subject, topic, status, XP, and Core Daily Practice flag so that I can schedule extra revision sessions.
Acceptance Criteria: Validates Day (1-31), Subject, Topic, Status, XP (5-100), and Core Daily flag; Newly added task appears immediately in calendar/Kanban and syncs mastery.

Feature: AI Sprint Recalculation & 3-Sheet CSV Spreadsheet Export
User Story: As a student, I want to recalculate my sprint schedule with AI and export my plan as a spreadsheet so that I can rebalance workload and review offline.
Acceptance Criteria: Recalculate AI Sprints posts to /api/study-planner/generate; Spreadsheet button downloads UTF-8 CSV containing Daily Planner, Weekly Sprint Board, and Master Chapter Tracker.

Feature: Weighted Course Progress Bar Chart & Card Toggle
User Story: As a student, I want to view my course mastery as an interactive bar chart or card grid calculated from my Agile task progress so that I see live syllabus impact.
Acceptance Criteria: Applies status weights (Done 1.0/Rev 0.75/InProg 0.45/Hold 0.15/ToDo 0.0) into 25 + ratio*75 (clamped 15-100); Updates instantaneously with zero refresh.

Feature: Interactive Course Drilldown & Direct AI Drill Launch
User Story: As a student, I want to click any course bar, legend, or card to inspect completed units, Agile task ratios, and launch an AI drill so that I can act on weak areas immediately.
Acceptance Criteria: Drilldown displays completed units, Agile done/total tasks, next scheduled topic, and Practice AI Drill CTA routing to ai-tutor.
Preconditions: User clicks bar legend or course card

Feature: Live Grade Board & Language Override Filters
User Story: As a student, I want to switch my preview Grade (6-12), Governing Board, and Language Medium from the dashboard rail so that I can explore aligned syllabi and open the Syllabus Explorer.
Acceptance Criteria: Updating Grade filters Skills Passport dynamically; Board/Language updates AppContext globally; View Syllabus opens CurriculumExplorerModal.

Feature: Study Momentum Streak & Inline Quick Doubts Feed
User Story: As a student, I want to track my 5-day streak, weekly core hours, and last 2 submitted doubts on the dashboard rail so that I stay on top of momentum and Q&A replies.
Acceptance Criteria: Shows 5-Day Streak, Weekly Core Math 10.5/10.5 hrs bar, Next Milestone, and live inline Quick Doubts submission displaying last 2 doubts with status.

Feature: Multi-Subject Formula & Diagram Search and Mode Filtering
User Story: As a student, I want to switch across 5 subjects (Math/Physics/Chemistry/History & Civics/Biology) and filter by Formulas, Diagrams, or keywords so that I find exam references fast.
Acceptance Criteria: 5 subject pills, All/Formulas/Diagrams toggle, and live text search filter titles, formulas, variables, examples, and annotations immediately.

Feature: Master Formula Cards with Worked Examples & Clipboard Copy
User Story: As a student, I want to review 16 curated formulas with variable units, worked examples, takeaways, and one-click copy so that I can revise problem-solving steps accurately.
Acceptance Criteria: Displays all 16 subject formulas with notation, SI units, example calculation, takeaway, and Copy button with copied-state confirmation.

Feature: Annotated SVG Board Diagrams & Fullscreen Lightbox
User Story: As a student, I want to inspect 5 annotated STEM & History SVG diagrams and expand them fullscreen so that complex labels and trajectories are crystal clear.
Acceptance Criteria: Renders DC Circuit, Bohr Sodium, Periodic Reference, Quadratic Parabola, and Freedom Movement 1857-1947 SVGs with fullscreen lightbox modal.

Feature: Interactive Periodic Table Z=1..82 & Family Filters
User Story: As a student, I want to browse elements Z=1 to Z=82 and filter by 8 chemical families or search by symbol/number so that I can study periodic properties interactively.
Acceptance Criteria: Covers elements Z=1..82; Search matches symbol/name/atomic number; 8 family pills highlight/filter alkali through noble-gas elements.
Preconditions: Chemistry subject selected in Formulas & Graphs

Feature: Dynamic SVG Bohr Orbit Visualizer & Trend Inspector
User Story: As a student, I want to view a live Bohr planetary shell diagram highlighting core vs valence electrons along with atomic trends so that I visualize electron configurations effortlessly.
Acceptance Criteria: Renders nucleus protons/neutrons, concentric electron shells, valence ring highlight, oxidation states, electronegativity, atomic radius, copy details, and periodic trend cards.

Feature: Grade-Filtered Curriculum & Live Syllabus Sync
User Story: As a student, I want my Skills Passport courses and active units to reflect my grade and update automatically when teachers edit the syllabus so that I always study current topics.
Acceptance Criteria: Filters subjectsDB and topicsDB by activeGradeFilter; Reflects WebSocket CURRICULUM_UPDATED changes live; Includes Grades 6-12 CurriculumExplorerModal launcher.

Feature: One-Click Unit Completion & Cross-Panel Sync
User Story: As a student, I want to mark a syllabus unit complete from my Skills Passport and launch related quizzes or AI drills so that my mastery updates everywhere immediately.
Acceptance Criteria: Clicking Complete invokes completeCurriculumUnit, prepending a 30 XP completed task and recalculating mastery across Student/Teacher/Admin; Quiz and AI Drill buttons route directly.
Preconditions: Active unit displayed on Skills Passport card

Feature: Academic KPI Scorecards & Continuous Evaluation Ledger
User Story: As a student, I want to view my GPA, board compliance (98%), overall mastery, attendance, and 6-course evaluation ledger so that I understand my standing across subjects.
Acceptance Criteria: Displays top academic KPI cards and 6-row Continuous Evaluation table with live percentages and per-course Launch Drill actions.

Feature: Faculty Review Request & AI Remedial Drill Trigger
User Story: As a student, I want to request a faculty grade review or start targeted AI practice for my weakest subject so that I can resolve discrepancies or close gaps fast.
Acceptance Criteria: Request Faculty Review dispatches live educator notification; AI Remedial Banner Start Targeted Practice navigates to ai-tutor with remedial prompt.

Feature: Quiz Catalog & Interactive MCQ Runner
User Story: As a student, I want to choose any grade quiz or live broadcast quiz and complete MCQs with a live answered counter so that I can test exam readiness.
Acceptance Criteria: Catalog shows grade, question count, attempts, and avgScore; Runner tracks A/B/C/D selections and live Answered X/Y counter before submission.

Feature: Quiz Grading Explanations & Real-Time GPA Sync
User Story: As a student, I want immediate grading with question-by-question explanations and automatic updates to my mastery and GPA so that I learn from mistakes right away.
Acceptance Criteria: Submit Answers & Sync grades MCQs, renders correctness and explanations, updates quiz attempts/avgScore, recalculates student GPA/mastery, and persists to localStorage.

Feature: Automated Verified Certificate Issuance at >=80% Score
User Story: As a student, I want to automatically earn a verified digital certificate whenever I score 80% or higher on a quiz so that my achievement is immediately credentialed.
Acceptance Criteria: Scores >=80% trigger automated DigitalCertificate generation with unique ID and 40-hex verification hash; Shows View Issued Certificate button on result screen.

Feature: Verified Digital Credentials Registry
User Story: As a student, I want to inspect all my earned certificates with credential IDs, scores, issue dates, and verification hashes so that I can share proof of mastery.
Acceptance Criteria: Displays all student DigitalCertificates showing course/quiz title, EDU-AI/PIVOTIQ ID, score %, issuer, date, Verified/Revoked badge, and 40-hex hash.

Feature: Board Grade & Language-Grounded Socratic Dialogue
User Story: As a student, I want the 24/7 AI Tutor to guide me Socratically in my selected board, grade, and language medium so that I build real conceptual understanding.
Acceptance Criteria: Injects currentBoard, studentGradeLevel, and globalLanguage into POST /api/tutor/chat; Renders Socratic hints, formula highlights, and Thinking Socratically indicator.

Feature: Summary Quick Prompt & Resilient Deterministic Fallback
User Story: As a student, I want a one-click Summary recap button and guaranteed tutor responses even if external AI latency occurs so that my study flow is never interrupted.
Acceptance Criteria: Summary button requests instant topic recap; Backend enforces 120s undici timeout and returns structured curriculum/multilingual fallback if Gemini call fails.

Feature: Homework Image Upload for Visual Doubt Context
User Story: As a student, I want to upload a photo of a textbook or handwritten problem to the AI Tutor so that I get guided help on visual diagrams and equations.
Acceptance Criteria: Accepts image/* via FileReader Data URL; Shows inline image preview before/with message; Appends visual homework prompt context.

Feature: Web Speech Voice-to-Text Question Input
User Story: As a student, I want to dictate questions using my microphone so that asking follow-ups while writing notes is effortless.
Acceptance Criteria: Uses SpeechRecognition/webkitSpeechRecognition toggle (Mic/MicOff) to transcribe speech into chat input; Shows safe fallback notice if browser lacks support.

Feature: Academic Doubt Feed Upvoting & Teacher-Verified Answers
User Story: As a student, I want to ask questions, reply to peers, upvote helpful doubts, and spot Teacher-Verified Solutions so that I learn collaboratively from trusted answers.
Acceptance Criteria: Supports creating posts, adding comments, toggling upvotes, and visually highlighting Teacher-Verified Solutions.

Feature: Zero-Tolerance Profanity Moderation & Account Lockout
User Story: As a student platform participant, I expect abusive or profane posts/comments to be blocked immediately and reported so that the learning community remains safe.
Acceptance Criteria: Both context and backend scan against TOXIC_PATTERNS; Violation returns HTTP 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED_POLICY_VIOLATION, suspends user, forces immediate logout, and alerts Admin Security Log.
Preconditions: Student submits post or comment in Community Q&A

Feature: Streak Freeze Safeguard Daily XP Bonus & Quests
User Story: As a student, I want to maintain my study streak with a Streak Freeze safeguard, claim daily +25 XP bonuses, and track quests and badges so that daily practice stays motivating.
Acceptance Criteria: 3 tabs (Streak & Safeguards, Daily XP Quests, Milestones & Badges); Claiming +25 XP triggers confetti; Level 4 Emerald League & 6 badges persist in localStorage.

Feature: 2G Low-Bandwidth Toggle & Standalone HTML Pack Download
User Story: As a student with limited internet, I want to toggle 2G Low-Bandwidth mode and download a self-contained HTML study pack so that I can revise offline or print to PDF.
Acceptance Criteria: Persists low-bandwidth flag in localStorage; Generates standalone .html file containing up to 15 daily tasks, 4 STEM summaries, and exam checklist; Supports window.print().

Feature: Sprint Progress Summary & 1-Page Printable PDF Report
User Story: As a student, I want to review my weekly sprint hours (91% completion) and generate a 1-page printable summary for my parents so that my progress is transparent at home.
Acceptance Criteria: Displays 26.0/28.5 hrs (91%) and 4-subject breakdown; Renders formatted 1-page PDF preview supporting window.print().

Feature: Guardian Auto-Dispatch Schedule & Test Email Simulation
User Story: As a student, I want to configure Sunday 07:00 PM IST automated guardian digest delivery and send a test digest so that parents receive reliable weekly updates.
Acceptance Criteria: Settings tab binds guardian name/email, Sunday 07:00 PM IST auto-dispatch toggle, and instant simulated test email dispatch confirmation.
